title: Eli
summary: High priest at Shiloh who judged Israel forty years; died aged 98 on hearing that the Ark was taken (1 Sam 4:15–18).
description: Added with the judges-period records from James B. Jordan's chronology (secondary display).

sorting_basis.note: Tier 3: Ussher-Jones (F. N. Jones): 1220 BC (no higher-tier year available). Jordan (secondary display) never sets the sort.

birth.date: "ELI BORN 1220 BC" (becomes priest 1190 BC; high priest 1162 BC)
birth.citation: Jones, Chart No. 4 "Judges to the First 3 Kings" (© 1993 Floyd Jones; chart text revised "As of 2007"), Eli life-line

birth.date: 2790d AM, 1214 BC ("Eli, the priest was born, for he died at the age of 98 years ... in the year of the world 2888")
birth.citation: Ussher, Annals of the World, Fourth Age §365 (paragraph numbering of the modern transcription)

birth.note: Jordan gives no birth year for Eli; he dates only the start of Eli's 40-year judgeship in the South: "2841 - Beginning of Eli's 40-year judgeship in the South (1 Sam. 4:18)" (From Creation to Solomon, 2001, p. 52) and "2815" in BC 3:8 (1991). Not converted into a birth year.

death.date: "around November or December of the previous year (1122 BC)", aged 98
death.citation: Jones, Chronology of the Old Testament (15th ed., 2002), ch. V "Chart Four", p. 87
Ussher, Annals of the World, Fourth Age §386 (paragraph numbering of the modern transcription)

death.date: "2881 - Death of Eli, beginning of Samuel's judgeship at Tabernacle ..."
death.citation: Jordan, From Creation to Solomon (Studies in Biblical Chronology No. 2, Biblical Horizons, Oct. 2001), ch. 11 "The Era of the Judges and the Reign of Saul", p. 52
death.note: 2001 revision. Jordan's 1991 list (BC 3:8) has an earlier year; see the second Jordan entry. Judgeship begun 2841 (p. 52), so 40 years to 2881.

death.citation: Jordan, "Chronology and Kings (II)," Biblical Chronology 3:8 (August 1991), section "The Judges", summary list
death.note: 1991 scheme, superseded by Jordan himself in 2001 (Studies in Biblical Chronology No. 2 dates the whole judges sequence 26 years later because he there ends the 300 years of Judg 11:26 when Ammon took the villages, AM 2860, not at Jephthah's victory). Judgeship begun 2815 ("2815 - Beginning of Eli's 40-year judgeship in the South (1 Sam. 4:18)").

death.date: Battle of Aphek, Eli dies. 2881 AM
death.citation: Anno Mundi Chronology Studies (unnamed compiler; a compilation of James B. Jordan's system), p. 8, chart "Year of the World: From the Judges to King Saul (Chronology from James Jordan)"
death.note: Agrees with Jordan's own published AM 2881.

reign.citation: Raleigh, The History of the World (1617, EEBO-TCP A10357), Chronological Table, sig. 786a
reign.note: Year cell "3553 2871 358". The third printed figure 358 is the column "Exodus", not a length. To the Reader (sig. 780b): the Julian Period exceeds the yeere of the World by 682. The 40 at the end of the name is the reign length he prints. The end year is not printed on this row. Column: Israel..
